plainTranslation:
This connection can be exciting and exhausting.

The Sun person may want consistency. The Uranus person may need freedom and change. The Sun person may try to build trust through routine or reassurance, while the Uranus person may feel trapped by too much predictability.

This can create a difficult pattern. The Sun person reaches for stability. Uranus pulls away. The Sun person feels unsafe and tries to create more structure. Uranus feels controlled and pushes back harder.

The attraction can be strong, but so can the instability. The Uranus person may feel thrilling to the Sun person, but also hard to rely on. The Sun person may feel grounding to Uranus, but also like a pressure they want to escape.

The danger is using freedom as a weapon. Canceling plans without warning, threatening to leave, creating drama when things are calm, or refusing to be consistent can make the Sun person feel like peace is never safe.

This aspect can create growth, but growth should not mean constant stress. Excitement is not the same as security.

For this to work, the Sun person needs to stay steady without becoming controlling. The Uranus person needs to ask for space without blowing up the relationship to get it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
